record_title: Complete ordering polytope for three pairwise-independent continuous observations
provenance: A sharp characterization of all labelled strict-order probabilities for three pairwise-independent observations with a common atomless marginal law, with exact rank-inference consequences and explicit torus extremizers.
limitations: Specific to three observations; sharp joint laws may be singular; conformal application uses two calibration scores; full texts of the closest 1997 and 2017 order-statistic sources were not inspected, leaving residual terminology-equivalence risk.
